title: I like getting things in the mail
text: I cancelled this subscription because everything in the box every month was also sold a walmart and total wouldn't cost me $25 dollars if bought individually at the store more like $15-20. And the hair products was terrible when I put in my hair and the product dried, my hair was hard and dried out, so to the trash it went, it was so much in the boxes that I didnt care for, the last box I got in December had 2 things in it, I chapstick and 2 mascara the rest my daughter took or put in trash.
